newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Multicanal is an outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Multicanal is an outperform.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley forecasts earnings for the firm at $0.21 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) in 1996, $0.06 per ADR in 1997 and $0.28 per ADR in 1998.
-- The brokerage said it estimates the company's consolidated adjusted operating cash flow will be $47.5 million in 1996 and $132.2 million in 1997.
-- "We believe the company is on the right track to meet our year-end estimates," the brokerage said in a report.
-- Multicanal Participacoes' ADR was up 3/8 at 13 7/8 while its voting common was flat at its Monday close of 1.44 reais at 1344 local/1544 GMT on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
